# AccuMeasure Instruments Co., Ltd.

> Official website: https://www.accumeasuretech.com
> Company: AccuMeasure Instruments Co., Ltd. (西安精准测量仪器有限公司)
> Location: High-Tech Zone, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China

## Company facts

- Founded in 2014.
- 2,600 sqm manufacturing and quality facility.
- 82 employees, 15 R&D engineers, 5 QC inspectors.
- Export markets: 40+.
- Every unit receives a 72-hour aging test and an individual calibration certificate.
- Standard factory warranty: 2 years.

## Product lines

- Level sensors: capacitive (AM-CL100), 80GHz radar (AM-RL80), ultrasonic (AM-UL20), and IoT WiFi (AM-WL50).
- Flow meters: electromagnetic (AM-EMF100), clamp-on ultrasonic (AM-UF200), and thermal mass (AM-MF50).
- Pressure instruments: piezoresistive pressure transmitter (AM-PT300) and digital pressure gauge (AM-PG200).
- OEM/ODM services: private label, custom ranges, custom firmware/display options, logo and packaging branding.

## Procurement facts

- Price from: $15 (FOB Xi'an).
- Samples: 1 sample unit at unit price plus shipping; sample cost is refundable against the first bulk order meeting MOQ.
- Bulk MOQ: 5 to 100 units depending on model.
- Standard lead time: 15-20 days; custom/OEM lead time: 25-35 days.
- Shipping: DHL/FedEx for samples (3-7 days); sea freight for bulk orders (15-35 days); air freight on request.
- Payment: T/T (30% deposit, 70% before shipment), L/C at sight, PayPal for samples, Alibaba Trade Assurance.
- Trade terms: FOB Xi'an / CIF / EXW per Incoterms 2020.
- Calibration certificate: included with every shipment.

## Compliance facts

- ISO 9001:2015, No. CN-2019-ISO-0347, by SGS.
- CE Marking, No. EC-1282/2023, by TÜV Rheinland.
- ATEX Ex d IIC T6, No. ATEX-2022-0158, by DEKRA.
- RoHS 3.0, No. RoHS-3.0-2024, by Intertek.
- FCC Part 15 is published for AM-WL50.
- IECEx Ex d IIC T6 is listed for AM-RL80; certificate number and issuer are not yet published on the public site.
